description: Procedure for cooking a flour-and-alum paste for covering and pasting. The dry mix is wetted smooth, diluted, then heated and stirred to a thick cookable consistency that can later be let down with warm water.
name: making paste

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter XX, p.280. Internet Archive.
Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (D. Appleton, 1901), Internet Archive

steps.description: Blend flour with powdered alum and just enough water to make a thin lump-free batter.
Stir in a larger volume of cold water and warm the mixture gently in an enamelled pan.
Stir steadily as it heats, then keep stirring for several minutes once it reaches the boil.
Hold until it sets into a thick paste, ready to be thinned with warm water as needed.
Store in a paste tub and beat smooth with a flat stick before each use.
